spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['deployment_environment'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'otelcol_process_uptime_seconds_total'
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['k8s_cluster_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'otelcol_process_uptime_seconds_total' AND match(tags['deployment_environment_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['k8s_node_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'otelcol_process_cpu_seconds_total' AND match(tags['k8s_cluster_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${deployment_environment_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_deployment_environment_name,
if(has([${host_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${host_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_host_name,
if(has([${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_k8s_cluster_name,
if(has([${k8s_node_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_node_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_k8s_node_name,
if(has([${service_instance_id:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_instance_id:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_instance_id,
if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "accepted_rate",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (signal_type_receiver) (
  label_join(
    label_replace(
      sum by (receiver) (
        rate(
          otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans_total{
            deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ',
            k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ',
            k8s_node_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_node_name), ',
            host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), ',
            service_instance_id=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_instance_id), ',
            service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '
          }[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']
        )
        +
        rate(
          otelcol_receiver_refused_spans_total{
            deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ',
            k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ',
            k8s_node_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_node_name), ',
            host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), ',
            service_instance_id=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_instance_id), ',
            service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '
          }[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']
        )
      ),
      "signal_type",
      "traces",
      "",
      ""
    )
    or
    label_replace(
      sum by (receiver) (
        rate(
          otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records_total{
            deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ',
            k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ',
            k8s_node_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_node_name), ',
            host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), ',
            service_instance_id=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_instance_id), ',
            service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '
          }[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']
        )
        +
        rate(
          otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records_total{
            deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ',
            k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ',
            k8s_node_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_node_name), ',
            host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), ',
            service_instance_id=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_instance_id), ',
            service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '
          }[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']
        )
      ),
      "signal_type",
      "logs",
      "",
      ""
    )
    or
    label_replace(
      sum by (receiver) (
        rate(
          otelcol_receiver_accepted_metric_points_total{
            deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ',
            k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ',
            k8s_node_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_node_name), ',
            host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), ',
            service_instance_id=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_instance_id), ',
            service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '
          }[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']
        )
        +
        rate(
          otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points_total{
            deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ',
            k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ',
            k8s_node_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_node_name), ',
            host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), ',
            service_instance_id=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_instance_id), ',
            service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '
          }[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']
        )
      ),
      "signal_type",
      "metrics",
      "",
      ""
    )
    ,
    "signal_type_receiver",
    "-",
    "signal_type",
    "receiver"
  )
)'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "error_pct",

FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (signal_type_receiver) (
  label_join(
    label_replace(
      (
        sum by (receiver) (
          rate(
            otelcol_receiver_refused_spans_total{
              deployment_environment_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_deployment_environment_name), ',
              k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ',
